law: REGISTRATION of E-Q15 — the preference reweighting probe (roadmap phase 13): a QTHE split-channel probe vs plain rejection sampling at IDENTICAL oracle budget. Committed BEFORE ANY RUN (pricing-first). Floors frozen; honest null = crown jewel.
claim_rw: A QTHE-byte preference memory (tau = stance, d = accumulated evidence, split-channel readout) picks a HIGHER-quality item than plain rejection sampling (best accepted so far) from the SAME oracle stream at the SAME budget.

design.task: 32 items, latent quality q_i in 1..63 (seeded). Oracle stream: B=120 proposals; each proposal picks item i (seeded uniform) and flips a seeded coin with P(accept) = q_i/63. BOTH arms consume the IDENTICAL stream (paired by construction — same mulberry32 draws, byte-for-byte).
design.arm_baseline: rejection sampling: track the max-q accepted item (classic best-of-accepted; if none accepted, item 0).
design.arm_probe: QTHE bytes: per item tau (3=uncertain start, 1=shortlist on accept, 2 stays unused), d=8 start (evidence amplitude). On accept: tau=1, d=min(63,d+4). On reject: uncertain item d=max(0,d-2); shortlisted item d=max(0,d-1) (soft demotion — no tau demotion: committed evidence is sticky). Final pick: argmax d among tau=1 items (the re channel carries the signed evidence; im channel = sum d over tau=3 = uncertainty mass, REPORTED, and if NO item ever accepted the probe falls back to argmax d overall — receipted as fallback, same as baseline's).
design.determinism: D1: every arm run twice from fresh construction; identical picks and identical probe byte-planes at end (hash), else VOID.

floors.EQ15_F0_determinism: run-twice byte-identical (picks + final probe plane hashes), 100/100 runs, else VOID.
floors.EQ15_F1_claim_floor: the probe WINS iff median(q_probe - q_baseline) >= +1 across 50 trials AND win-rate (strict q_probe > q_baseline) >= 55%. Anything less: RW DIES as an honest null with a mechanism autopsy (where the evidence compounding lost to max-of-accepted).
floors.EQ15_F2_pairing_check: the two arms consume byte-identical oracle streams (assert: same accept sequence length + same accepted-item multiset), else VOID (pairing broken).

sealed_honest_expectation: uncertain. The probe's edge: d COMPOUNDS across repeated accepts (evidence accumulation) and sticky shortlisting resists late noise; the baseline's edge: max-of-accepted is a hard lower bound that already exploits acceptance-correlated quality, and d-compounding can promote a repeatedly-accepted mediocre item over a once-accepted excellent one. Both failure modes are one sentence each; the run decides.
receipt_discipline: one stone-v1 chain receipts/e_q15_chain.jsonl; outputs experiments/outputs/e_q15_results.json + tip file; floats (the accept probability) only as receipted strings — all metrics are integers (q values, counts).
registered_before_run: YES — no E-Q15 tick has executed at commit time. Git history is the witness.
